assertions.subject: Compressive radial mononeuropathy
assertions.quote: Compressive radial mononeuropathy results after immobilization in an unnatural position, resulting in prolonged compressive damage to the radial nerve.

assertions.subject: Compressive radial mononeuropathy
assertions.quote: Compressive radial mononeuropathy is relatively common and has been reported to affect 2.97 per 100,000 men and 1.42 per 100,000 women.

assertions.subject: Compressive radial mononeuropathy

assertions.subject: Compressive radial mononeuropathy
assertions.quote: Sensory deficits often involve the posterior or lateral upper arm, with symptoms extending distally to affect the posterior forearm, posterior hand, and posterolateral aspect of the lateral three-and-a-half digits.
